design_decisions.title: Keep the first revision debug-first
design_decisions.rationale: Can continue: the board should expose UART0, BOOT0/FEL, reset, and boot storage paths before higher-risk expansion features are finalized.
design_decisions.impact: Improves bring-up visibility and reduces recovery risk.

design_decisions.title: Keep UART0 on the board edge
design_decisions.rationale: Can continue: the first bring-up loop depends on an easily probed UART0 console path for boot logs and recovery diagnostics.
design_decisions.impact: Makes early failures diagnosable without relying on higher-risk interfaces.

design_decisions.title: Resolve DDR topology for V1
design_decisions.rationale: Can continue: LPDDR4 is now mapped to the current V1 board topology and will not drift without a revision bump.
design_decisions.impact: Keeps the DDR block deterministic for procurement and bring-up.

design_decisions.title: Resolve DDR block for the current board revision
design_decisions.rationale: Can continue: the LPDDR4 block is now a board-level topology for V1 and should only change in a future revision.
design_decisions.impact: Prevents the model from drifting away from the board currently being generated.

design_decisions.title: Resolve high-speed interfaces for V1
design_decisions.rationale: Can continue: RGMII, USB hub, HDMI, and USB-C are now tied to the current board revision and should not be expanded without a new revision.
design_decisions.impact: Keeps the external interface set stable for procurement and layout.

design_decisions.title: Reserve future co-processor interface area
design_decisions.rationale: Can continue: an RP2040 or ESP32-class controller can later automate target power, reset, and logging workflows.
design_decisions.impact: Keeps the board extensible without committing to the secondary MCU now.

design_decisions.title: Resolve the conventional H618 Linux board set
design_decisions.rationale: Can continue: AXP313A, SPI NOR, MicroSD, RTL8211F-class PHY, and USB hub are now the fixed V1 board set.
design_decisions.impact: The example remains aligned with a conventional H618 layout for the current revision.

design_decisions.title: Resolve USB-C power input as sink
design_decisions.rationale: Can continue: the Type-C receptacle has explicit 5.1k Rd resistors on CC1 and CC2 and the protection chain is now fixed for V1.
design_decisions.impact: Improves first-revision power-entry correctness while keeping the circuit simple.
